snippet.title: Castlebound - Official New Demo Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Get a fresh look at gameplay from Castlebound in this latest trailer for the upcoming action-packed roguelike game. In Castlebound, lead a band of heroes in a walking castle to battle endless hordes of enemies. Castlebound will be available on Nintendo Switch and Steam in 2026. A new demo is out now on Steam.
